parameters.query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN posting_number ~ '^[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
            THEN regexp_replace(posting_number, '-[0-9]+$', '')
        ELSE posting_number
    END AS posting_key,

    SUM(amount) AS total_amount

FROM finance_operations

WHERE operation_type IN (
    'OperationReturnGoodsFBSofRMS',
    'OperationMarketplacePackageMaterialsProvision',
    'OperationMarketplacePackageRedistribution',
    'InsuranceServiceSellerItem',
    'OperationMarketplaceCostPerClick',
    'DisposalOfGoods',
    'ClientReturnAgentOperation'
)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 50;

SELECT tablename
FROM pg_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'public'
ORDER BY tablename;

SELECT
    s.posting_number,
    p.posting_key,

    s.profit        AS old_profit,
    p.profit        AS new_profit,

    s.revenue       AS old_revenue,
    p.revenue       AS new_revenue,

    s.commission    AS old_commission,
    p.commission    AS new_commission,

    s.delivery      AS old_delivery,
    p.logistics     AS new_delivery,

    s.cost_price    AS old_cost,
    p.cost_price    AS new_cost

FROM sales s

JOIN vw_orders_profit p

ON
CASE
WHEN s.posting_number ~ '^[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
THEN regexp_replace(s.posting_number,'-[0-9]+$','')
ELSE s.posting_number
END = p.posting_key

LIMIT 30;

SELECT
    routine_schema,
    routine_name
FROM information_schema.routines
WHERE routine_schema = 'public'
  AND (
      routine_name ILIKE '%stock%'
      OR routine_name ILIKE '%остат%'
      OR routine_name ILIKE '%snapshot%'
      OR routine_name ILIKE '%history%'
  )
ORDER BY routine_name;

parameters.toolDescription:
Получает текущие проблемы товаров Ozon из представления vw_product_alerts.

Используй этот инструмент только для анализа текущих проблем товаров, причин проблем, приоритетов и рекомендуемых действий.

Инструмент возвращает только товары с priority = HIGH.

Используй поля:
- offer_id
- reasons
- соответствующие alert-поля
- максимум 3 исходных поля из orders_count, avg_profit, commission_rate, logistics_rate, profit_margin
- recommended_action

reasons и recommended_action выводи дословно.

Показывай только alert-поля, соответствующие причинам конкретного товара.

Если причина отсутствует в reasons, соответствующий alert не показывай.

Не создавай собственных причин, действий, оценок, нормативов или интерпретаций.

Не изменяй значения полей, reasons, recommended_action или alert.

Инструмент только читает данные и ничего не изменяет в базе.

Не дублируй reasons отдельным блоком «Итог». Не повторяй уже показанные причины без дополнительного аналитического вывода.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        30::integer AS days
),

posting_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.quantity, 0)) AS units,
        MAX(COALESCE(pr.cost_price, 0)) AS unit_cost
    FROM postings p
    LEFT JOIN products pr
        ON pr.offer_id = p.offer_id
    GROUP BY
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku
),

finance_data AS (
    SELECT
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku,
        MIN(f.operation_date) AS operation_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.accruals_for_sale, 0)) AS revenue,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.sale_commission, 0)) AS commission,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.service_amount, 0)) AS logistics,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.amount, 0)) AS payout
    FROM finance_operations f
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        f.operation_type = 'OperationAgentDeliveredToCustomer'
        AND f.posting_number IS NOT NULL
        AND f.accruals_for_sale > 0
        AND f.operation_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku,
        p.units,
        p.unit_cost,
        f.operation_date,
        f.revenue,
        f.commission,
        f.logistics,
        f.payout,
        p.units * p.unit_cost AS cost
    FROM posting_data p
    INNER JOIN finance_data f
        ON f.posting_number = p.posting_number
       AND f.sku = p.sku
),

product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number) AS orders_count,
        SUM(units) AS delivered_units,
        SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
        SUM(commission) AS commission,
        SUM(logistics) AS logistics,
        SUM(payout) AS payout,
        SUM(cost) AS cost,
        SUM(payout) - SUM(cost) AS profit
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY
        offer_id
),

metrics AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        orders_count,
        delivered_units,
        revenue,
        commission,
        logistics,
        payout,
        cost,
        profit,

        CASE
            WHEN delivered_units > 0
            THEN profit / delivered_units
            ELSE 0
        END AS profit_per_unit,

        CASE
            WHEN revenue > 0
            THEN ABS(commission) / revenue * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS commission_rate,

        CASE
            WHEN revenue > 0
            THEN ABS(logistics) / revenue * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS logistics_rate,

        CASE
            WHEN revenue > 0
            THEN profit / revenue * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS profit_margin,

        CASE
            WHEN delivered_units > 0
            THEN ABS(logistics) / delivered_units
            ELSE 0
        END AS logistics_per_unit,

        ABS(commission) / NULLIF(orders_count, 0) AS commission_per_order

    FROM product_metrics
),

classified AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,

        CASE
            WHEN m.profit_per_unit < 70
                THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN m.profit_per_unit < 110
                THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS profit_alert,

        CASE
            WHEN m.logistics_per_unit > 100
                THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN m.logistics_per_unit > 95
                THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS logistics_alert,

        CASE
            WHEN m.commission_per_order > 320
                THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN m.commission_per_order > 280
                THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS commission_alert

    FROM metrics m
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    CASE
        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'HIGH'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 'MEDIUM'

        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS priority,

    orders_count,
    delivered_units,

    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(commission, 2) AS commission,
    ROUND(logistics, 2) AS logistics,
    ROUND(payout, 2) AS payout,
    ROUND(cost, 2) AS cost,
    ROUND(profit, 2) AS profit,
    ROUND(profit_per_unit, 2) AS profit_per_unit,
    ROUND(commission_rate, 2) AS commission_rate,
    ROUND(logistics_rate, 2) AS logistics_rate,
    ROUND(profit_margin, 2) AS profit_margin,
    ROUND(logistics_per_unit, 2) AS logistics_per_unit,
    ROUND(commission_per_order, 2) AS commission_per_order,

    profit_alert,
    logistics_alert,
    commission_alert,

    CONCAT_WS(
        '; ',

        CASE
            WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
                THEN 'Критически низкая прибыль'
            WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
                THEN 'Низкая прибыль'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
                THEN 'Повышенная стоимость логистики'
            WHEN logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
                THEN 'Повышенная логистика'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN commission_alert = 'HIGH'
                THEN 'Высокая комиссия OZON'
            WHEN commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
                THEN 'Повышенная комиссия OZON'
        END
    ) AS reasons,

    CASE

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
         AND logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
         AND commission_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
        THEN
            'Проверить прибыльность, стоимость логистики и комиссию OZON. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
         AND logistics_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
         AND commission_alert = 'LOW'
        THEN
            'Проверить прибыльность и стоимость логистики. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
         AND logistics_alert = 'LOW'
         AND commission_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
        THEN
            'Проверить прибыльность и комиссию OZON. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN
            'Проверить причины низкой прибыльности. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert IN ('MEDIUM', 'LOW')
         AND logistics_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
         AND commission_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
        THEN
            'Проверить стоимость логистики и комиссию OZON.'

        WHEN profit_alert IN ('MEDIUM', 'LOW')
         AND logistics_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
         AND commission_alert = 'LOW'
        THEN
            'Проверить стоимость логистики.'

        WHEN profit_alert IN ('MEDIUM', 'LOW')
         AND logistics_alert = 'LOW'
         AND commission_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
        THEN
            'Проверить комиссию OZON.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN
            'Проверить прибыльность товара. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        ELSE
            'Существенных действий не требуется.'
    END AS recommended_action

FROM classified

WHERE
    profit_alert <> 'LOW'
    OR logistics_alert <> 'LOW'
    OR commission_alert <> 'LOW'

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END,
    profit_per_unit ASC,
    offer_id;

SELECT
    offer_id,

    CASE
        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'HIGH'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 'MEDIUM'

        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS priority,

    orders_count,
    avg_profit,
    commission_rate,
    logistics_rate,
    profit_margin,

    profit_alert,
    logistics_alert,
    commission_alert,

    CONCAT_WS(
        '; ',

        CASE
            WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
            THEN 'Критически низкая прибыль'
            WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
            THEN 'Проблема с прибыльностью'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
            THEN 'Повышенная стоимость логистики'
            WHEN logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
            THEN 'Повышенная стоимость логистики'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN commission_alert = 'HIGH'
            THEN 'Высокая комиссия OZON'
            WHEN commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
            THEN 'Повышенная комиссия OZON'
        END

    ) AS reasons,

    CASE
        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
             AND logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
             AND commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить причины низкой прибыльности, стоимость логистики и комиссию OZON. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
             AND logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить причины низкой прибыльности и стоимость логистики. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
             AND commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить причины низкой прибыльности и комиссию OZON. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить причины низкой прибыльности. Цену автоматически не менять.'

        WHEN logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
             AND commission_alert IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
        THEN 'Проверить стоимость логистики и комиссию OZON.'

        WHEN logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить стоимость логистики.'

        WHEN commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 'Проверить комиссию OZON.'

        WHEN logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
             AND commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 'Наблюдать и проверить структуру расходов.'

        WHEN logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 'Наблюдать и проверить стоимость логистики.'

        WHEN commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 'Наблюдать и проверить комиссию OZON.'

        ELSE 'Существенных действий не требуется.'
    END AS recommended_action

FROM vw_product_alerts

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN profit_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR logistics_alert = 'HIGH'
          OR commission_alert = 'HIGH'
        THEN 1

        WHEN profit_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR logistics_alert = 'MEDIUM'
          OR commission_alert = 'MEDIUM'
        THEN 2

        ELSE 3
    END,

    orders_count DESC;

SELECT
    m.offer_id,

    m.orders_count,
    m.revenue,
    m.profit,
    m.avg_profit,
    m.avg_revenue,
    m.avg_commission,
    m.avg_logistics,
    m.avg_payout,
    m.cost_price,
    m.current_price,

    COALESCE(r.return_rows, 0) AS return_rows,
    COALESCE(r.returned_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity,
    COALESCE(r.returned_amount, 0) AS returned_amount,
    COALESCE(r.reasons_count, 0) AS reasons_count,
    COALESCE(r.statuses_count, 0) AS statuses_count,
    r.first_return_date,
    r.last_return_date

FROM vw_product_metrics m

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS return_rows,
        SUM(quantity) AS returned_quantity,
        ROUND(SUM(price * quantity), 2) AS returned_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT return_reason) AS reasons_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT return_status) AS statuses_count,
        MIN(logistic_return_date) AS first_return_date,
        MAX(logistic_return_date) AS last_return_date
    FROM returns
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
    ON r.offer_id = m.offer_id

ORDER BY m.offer_id;

parameters.toolDescription:
Основной финансово-продажный инструмент Ozon. Используй для конкретного товара и общей аналитики за заданный период. Возвращает фактические доставленные единицы, количество заказов, выручку, комиссию, логистику, выплату Ozon, себестоимость и итоговую прибыль.

Параметры: offer_id и days. Если период не указан — 30 дней.

Соответствие: orders_count — количество заказов; delivered_units — проданные доставленные единицы; revenue — выручка; commission — комиссия; logistics — логистика; payout — выплата Ozon; cost — фактическая себестоимость проданных единиц; profit — payout минус cost; profit_per_unit — прибыль на единицу.

Для вопросов о прибыли используй именно profit, а не avg_profit. Для средней прибыли используй profit_per_unit только если пользователь спрашивает прибыль на единицу. Не используй этот инструмент для истории цен, возвратов или региональной аналитики.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество последних дней для анализа. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

posting_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.quantity, 0)) AS units,
        MAX(COALESCE(pr.cost_price, 0)) AS unit_cost
    FROM postings p
    LEFT JOIN products pr
        ON pr.offer_id = p.offer_id
    GROUP BY
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku
),

finance_data AS (
    SELECT
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku,
        MIN(f.operation_date) AS operation_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.accruals_for_sale, 0)) AS revenue,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.sale_commission, 0)) AS commission,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.service_amount, 0)) AS logistics,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.amount, 0)) AS payout
    FROM finance_operations f
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        f.operation_type = 'OperationAgentDeliveredToCustomer'
        AND f.posting_number IS NOT NULL
        AND f.accruals_for_sale > 0
        AND f.operation_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.units,
        p.unit_cost,
        f.operation_date,
        f.revenue,
        f.commission,
        f.logistics,
        f.payout,
        p.units * p.unit_cost AS cost
    FROM posting_data p
    INNER JOIN finance_data f
        ON f.posting_number = p.posting_number
       AND f.sku = p.sku
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        p.offer_id = prm.offer_id
        OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number) AS orders_count,

    SUM(units) AS delivered_units,

    ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue,

    ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS commission,

    ROUND(SUM(logistics), 2) AS logistics,

    ROUND(SUM(payout), 2) AS payout,

    ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS cost,

    ROUND(
        SUM(payout) - SUM(cost),
        2
    ) AS profit,

    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_sale_price,

    ROUND(
        SUM(payout) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_payout,

    ROUND(
        SUM(commission) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_commission,

    ROUND(
        SUM(logistics) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_logistics,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(payout) - SUM(cost)
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0),
        2
    ) AS profit_per_unit,

    MIN(operation_date) AS first_sale_date,

    MAX(operation_date) AS last_sale_date

FROM sales_data

GROUP BY
    offer_id

ORDER BY
    profit DESC,
    offer_id;

CREATE TABLE public.stock_history (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    snapshot_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT date_trunc('minute', now()),
    offer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_id BIGINT,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    present INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sku BIGINT
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_stock_history_snapshot
ON public.stock_history (snapshot_at, offer_id, type);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.posting_logistics (
    posting_number TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    order_number TEXT,

    city TEXT,
    region TEXT,
    district TEXT,

    delivery_type TEXT,

    warehouse TEXT,
    warehouse_id BIGINT,

    tpl_provider TEXT,
    tpl_provider_id BIGINT,

    cluster_from TEXT,
    cluster_to TEXT,

    updated_from_ozon TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO public.stock_history (
    snapshot_at,
    offer_id,
    product_id,
    type,
    present,
    reserved,
    sku
)
SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', now()),
    offer_id,
    product_id,
    type,
    COALESCE(present, 0),
    COALESCE(reserved, 0),
    sku
FROM public.stocks
ON CONFLICT (snapshot_at, offer_id, type)
DO NOTHING;

SELECT
    DATE(p.updated_from_ozon) AS updated_date,
    p.status,
    COUNT(*) AS postings_count
FROM public.postings p
LEFT JOIN public.posting_logistics pl
    ON pl.posting_number = p.posting_number
WHERE pl.posting_number IS NULL
GROUP BY DATE(p.updated_from_ozon), p.status
ORDER BY updated_date, p.status;

parameters.toolDescription:
Региональная аналитика продаж Ozon.

Используй этот инструмент, когда пользователь спрашивает:
- в каких регионах продается товар;
- где самая высокая или низкая логистика;
- сравнение логистики по регионам;
- прибыль товара по регионам;
- выручку по регионам;
- количество проданных единиц по регионам;
- эффективность товара в разных регионах.

Инструмент возвращает:
region,
offer_id,
units,
postings_count,
revenue,
commission,
logistics,
payout,
profit,
logistics_per_unit,
profit_per_unit.

Для конкретного товара обязательно передавай точный offer_id.
Для общей региональной аналитики используй ALL.

Не делай выводов о регионах, которых нет в результате инструмента.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество последних дней для анализа. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

target_postings AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.quantity, 0)) AS units,
        MAX(COALESCE(pr.cost_price, 0)) AS unit_cost
    FROM postings p
    LEFT JOIN products pr
        ON pr.offer_id = p.offer_id
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        p.offer_id = prm.offer_id
        OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
    GROUP BY
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku
),

finance_data AS (
    SELECT
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku,
        MIN(f.operation_date) AS operation_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.accruals_for_sale, 0)) AS revenue,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.sale_commission, 0)) AS commission,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.service_amount, 0)) AS logistics,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.amount, 0)) AS payout
    FROM finance_operations f
    INNER JOIN target_postings tp
        ON tp.posting_number = f.posting_number
       AND tp.sku = f.sku
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        f.operation_type = 'OperationAgentDeliveredToCustomer'
        AND f.posting_number IS NOT NULL
        AND f.accruals_for_sale > 0
        AND f.operation_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku
),

logistics_data AS (
    SELECT
        pl.posting_number,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(pl.cluster_to), '')),
            MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(pl.region), '')),
            MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(pl.city), '')),
            'Не указан'
        ) AS region
    FROM posting_logistics pl
    INNER JOIN target_postings tp
        ON tp.posting_number = pl.posting_number
    GROUP BY
        pl.posting_number
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        tp.posting_number,
        tp.offer_id,
        tp.units,
        tp.unit_cost,
        fd.operation_date,
        fd.revenue,
        fd.commission,
        fd.logistics,
        fd.payout,
        tp.units * tp.unit_cost AS cost,
        COALESCE(ld.region, 'Не указан') AS region
    FROM target_postings tp

    INNER JOIN finance_data fd
        ON fd.posting_number = tp.posting_number
       AND fd.sku = tp.sku

    LEFT JOIN logistics_data ld
        ON ld.posting_number = tp.posting_number
)

SELECT
    region,
    offer_id,

    SUM(units) AS units,

    COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number) AS postings_count,

    ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue,

    ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS commission,

    ROUND(SUM(logistics), 2) AS logistics,

    ROUND(SUM(payout), 2) AS payout,

    ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS cost,

    ROUND(
        SUM(payout) - SUM(cost),
        2
    ) AS profit,

    ROUND(
        SUM(ABS(logistics))
        / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0),
        2
    ) AS logistics_per_unit,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(payout) - SUM(cost)
        )
        / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0),
        2
    ) AS profit_per_unit

FROM sales_data

GROUP BY
    region,
    offer_id

ORDER BY
    logistics_per_unit DESC,
    region;

parameters.toolDescription: Анализирует историю цен товаров Ozon. Используй для вопросов об изменении цены, текущей и предыдущей цене, минимальной и максимальной цене, количестве изменений и динамике цены за период. Для конкретного товара передавай offer_id. Если offer_id не указан, используй ALL. Параметр days задаёт количество последних дней для анализа, по умолчанию 30. Не используй этот инструмент для анализа продаж, прибыли, логистики или остатков.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество последних дней для анализа. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

price_data AS (
    SELECT
        h.offer_id,
        h.price,
        h.updated_from_ozon
    FROM ozon_price_history h
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        h.updated_from_ozon >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
        AND (
            h.offer_id = prm.offer_id
            OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
        )
),

price_changes AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        price,
        updated_from_ozon,
        LAG(price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY offer_id
            ORDER BY updated_from_ozon
        ) AS previous_price
    FROM price_data
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    COUNT(*) AS observations,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE previous_price IS NOT NULL
          AND price IS DISTINCT FROM previous_price
    ) AS price_changes,

    ROUND(MIN(price), 2) AS min_price,

    ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS max_price,

    ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price,

    ROUND(
        (
            ARRAY_AGG(
                price
                ORDER BY updated_from_ozon DESC
            )
        )[1],
        2
    ) AS current_price,

    ROUND(
        (
            ARRAY_AGG(
                price
                ORDER BY updated_from_ozon ASC
            )
        )[1],
        2
    ) AS first_price,

    ROUND(
        (
            (
                ARRAY_AGG(
                    price
                    ORDER BY updated_from_ozon DESC
                )
            )[1]
            -
            (
                ARRAY_AGG(
                    price
                    ORDER BY updated_from_ozon ASC
                )
            )[1]
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_price_change,

    ROUND(
        (
            (
                (
                    ARRAY_AGG(
                        price
                        ORDER BY updated_from_ozon DESC
                    )
                )[1]
                -
                (
                    ARRAY_AGG(
                        price
                        ORDER BY updated_from_ozon ASC
                    )
                )[1]
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                (
                    ARRAY_AGG(
                        price
                        ORDER BY updated_from_ozon ASC
                    )
                )[1],
                0
            )
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS total_price_change_percent,

    MAX(updated_from_ozon) AS last_updated

FROM price_changes

GROUP BY
    offer_id

ORDER BY
    offer_id;

parameters.toolDescription: Анализирует детальные возвраты товаров Ozon из таблицы returns. Используй для вопросов о количестве возвратов, возвращённых единицах, сумме возвратов, причинах и статусах возвратов за заданный период. Для конкретного товара используй offer_id. Не используй этот инструмент для общей прибыли, продаж, остатков или региональной логистики.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество дней для анализа возвратов. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.offer_id,
        r.product_name,
        r.quantity,
        r.price,
        r.return_reason,
        r.return_status,
        r.logistic_return_date
    FROM returns r
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        r.logistic_return_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
        AND (
            r.offer_id = prm.offer_id
            OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
        )
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    COUNT(*) AS return_count,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(quantity),
        0
    ) AS returned_units,

    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(price * quantity), 0),
        2
    ) AS returned_amount,

    COUNT(DISTINCT return_reason) AS reasons_count,

    COUNT(DISTINCT return_status) AS statuses_count,

    MIN(logistic_return_date) AS first_return_date,

    MAX(logistic_return_date) AS last_return_date,

    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
                'reason', return_reason,
                'status', return_status
            )
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE return_reason IS NOT NULL
               OR return_status IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS return_details

FROM filtered_returns

GROUP BY
    offer_id

ORDER BY
    offer_id;

parameters.toolDescription: Анализирует историю остатков товаров Ozon из таблицы stock_history. Используй для вопросов об изменении остатков, динамике FBO/FBS, текущем и среднем остатке, минимальном и максимальном остатке, количестве изменений и периодах дефицита. Поддерживает offer_id и период days. Не используй для анализа продаж, прибыли, логистики или возвратов.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество последних дней для анализа истории остатков. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

stock_data AS (
    SELECT
        h.snapshot_at,
        h.offer_id,
        h.product_id,
        h.type,
        h.present,
        h.reserved,
        h.sku
    FROM stock_history h
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        h.snapshot_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - prm.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
        AND (
            h.offer_id = prm.offer_id
            OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
        )
),

stock_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        snapshot_at,
        offer_id,
        product_id,
        type,
        present,
        reserved,
        sku,

        LAG(present) OVER (
            PARTITION BY offer_id, type
            ORDER BY snapshot_at
        ) AS previous_present

    FROM stock_data
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    type,

    COUNT(*) AS observations,

    (
        ARRAY_AGG(
            present
            ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC
        )
    )[1] AS current_stock,

    ROUND(
        AVG(present),
        2
    ) AS avg_stock,

    MIN(present) AS min_stock,

    MAX(present) AS max_stock,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE previous_present IS NOT NULL
          AND present <> previous_present
    ) AS stock_changes,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE present = 0
    ) AS zero_stock_observations,

    ROUND(
        AVG(reserved),
        2
    ) AS avg_reserved,

    MAX(reserved) AS max_reserved,

    MIN(snapshot_at) AS first_snapshot,

    MAX(snapshot_at) AS last_snapshot

FROM stock_with_lag

GROUP BY
    offer_id,
    type

ORDER BY
    offer_id,
    type;

parameters.toolDescription:
ТОЛЬКО для анализа фактических продаж за период.
Используй этот инструмент, когда пользователь спрашивает: сколько продано, количество проданных единиц, количество заказов, выручку от продаж, среднюю цену продажи, скорость продаж, продажи в день, динамику продаж за период.

Параметры: offer_id и days.

НЕ используй этот инструмент для прибыли, комиссии, логистики, возвратов, остатков, истории цен или региональной аналитики. Для этих задач используй другие инструменты.

Если пользователь спрашивает о продажах конкретного товара — обязательно вызови этот инструмент, даже если другой инструмент может содержать похожие показатели.

Если пользователь указал период в днях — передай его в days. Если период не указан — используй 30.

offer_id — артикул Ozon. Для общей аналитики передавай ALL.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $fromAI("offer_id", "Артикул Ozon (offer_id). Для конкретного товара передай offer_id. Для общей аналитики передай ALL.", "string", "ALL") }}' AS offer_id,
        '{{ $fromAI("days", "Количество последних дней для анализа продаж. По умолчанию 30.", "string", "30") }}'::integer AS days
),

posting_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.quantity, 0)) AS units
    FROM postings p
    GROUP BY
        p.posting_number,
        p.offer_id,
        p.sku
),

finance_data AS (
    SELECT
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku,
        MIN(f.operation_date) AS operation_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.accruals_for_sale, 0)) AS revenue
    FROM finance_operations f
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE
        f.operation_type = 'OperationAgentDeliveredToCustomer'
        AND f.posting_number IS NOT NULL
        AND f.operation_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            - p.days * INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY
        f.posting_number,
        f.sku
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.offer_id,
        p.posting_number,
        p.units,
        f.operation_date,
        f.revenue
    FROM posting_data p
    INNER JOIN finance_data f
        ON f.posting_number = p.posting_number
       AND f.sku = p.sku
    CROSS JOIN params prm
    WHERE
        p.offer_id = prm.offer_id
        OR prm.offer_id = 'ALL'
)

SELECT
    offer_id,

    COUNT(DISTINCT posting_number) AS orders_count,

    SUM(units) AS sold_units,

    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue),
        2
    ) AS revenue,

    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_sale_price,

    ROUND(
        SUM(units)::numeric
        / NULLIF(
            GREATEST(
                EXTRACT(
                    DAY FROM (
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        - (
                            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                            - (SELECT days FROM params) * INTERVAL '1 day'
                        )
                    )
                ),
                1
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS sales_per_day,

    MIN(operation_date) AS first_sale_date,

    MAX(operation_date) AS last_sale_date

FROM sales_data

GROUP BY
    offer_id

ORDER BY
    sold_units DESC,
    offer_id;

parameters.toolDescription: Возвращает готовые детерминированные read-only рекомендации Price & Profit Recommendation Engine. Используй для вопросов об изменении цены, низкой прибыли или марже, необходимости повышения цены, сохранении цены и проверке качества данных. Параметры: offer_id — точный offer_id или строка null для всех товаров; action — KEEP, CONSIDER_RAISE, REVIEW_DATA или строка null для всех действий. Не вызывает изменение цен. Не рассчитывай proposed_price: если в ответе proposed_price равно null, сообщи, что подтверждённой модели целевой цены нет.

values.name: offer_id
values.description: Canonical offer_id товара. Для всех товаров передай строку null.

values.description: KEEP, CONSIDER_RAISE, REVIEW_DATA. Для всех действий передай строку null.
